parsed.missing_from_rule: The rule does not specify that the beneficiary must have been using a BGM (blood glucose monitor); it only checks the frequency of testing, not whether a BGM was actually used.
parsed.explanation: The policy requires both that the beneficiary has been using a BGM and that they have been performing frequent testing (four or more times a day). The rule only checks the frequency of testing, not whether a BGM was used. This could allow claims where the beneficiary did not use a BGM, which would not be allowed under the policy.
